title: F3 agent output (PREREG v0.3 section 6.1; read by audit/v03/f3_compare.py)
description: The F3 agent writes, into its output folder: <world_seed>.json for every test world (per_world_file), cal_<world_seed>.json for every calibration world (calibration_world_file), tau.json (tau_file) and verdict_table.json (verdict_table_file). Every fraction is a string "p/q" in lowest terms with q >= 1 (an integer n is written "n/1", zero "0/1", a negative value has a leading minus); an undefined metric is null. No floats anywhere. The one plain integer among the metrics is n_q. Alpha levels are strings spelled as in the input's configuration keys ("0.95", "0.9", ..., "0.5"). Configuration keys are written exactly as in the input's "configs" (alpha as printed there, a vertical bar, k), for example "0.95|0" and "0.7|5".

n_q.description: The denominator of new_false: the number of vocabulary atoms outside I that are T or F in the verdict view, as a plain integer (R1-1).

metrics.description: Every metric of SPEC section 8 at every one of the 30 grid points: {"<alpha>|<k>": {metric: fraction or null}}.

feasible.description: Configuration keys of the feasible points under the tau of tau.json (fidelity >= tau_s, deviation <= tau_d, consistency >= tau_t, uncertainty <= tau_b; all four defined, and new_true defined), over all 30 configurations, in any order.

pareto_front.description: Configuration keys of the non-dominated feasible points (x = 1 - new_false, y = new_true), ordered x descending, then y descending, then alpha ascending, then k ascending.

hypervolume.description: Area of the union of the rectangles [0, x] x [0, y] over the feasible points, exactly.

t1_structure.description: T-1's structure in this world (PREREG v0.3 section 3.2, I-5; INSTRUCTIONS_F3.md step 8). feasible_alphas is written for every world, largest level first; defined is true iff the T-1 outcome is not UNDEFINED; on an undefined world the other five fields are null.

calibration_world_file.description: cal_<world_seed>.json of a calibration world: its eight metrics and n_q at the single configuration "0.7|0".

tau_file.description: tau.json: tau by the Q-40 rule of PREREG v0.3 section 7 from the 40 calibration worlds' metrics at (alpha0, 0): tau_s the 4th smallest fidelity, tau_t the 4th smallest consistency, tau_d the 4th largest deviation, tau_b the 4th largest uncertainty.

verdict_table_file.description: verdict_table.json: one row per test (G1..G6 from the given per-world outcomes, G7 = G7a, T-1), by the rules of PREREG v0.3 sections 3.3 and 4, and t1_structure_counts. There is no G8 row. The Wilson lower bound is a string with three decimals for T-1 (as printed in the verdict text) and null for the deterministic tests.

first_failing_world.description: The world_seed of the FAILS world with the smallest draw_index, or null if no world FAILS.

t1_structure_counts.description: The counts of T-1's structure over the worlds whose T-1 outcome is defined (INSTRUCTIONS_F3.md, the verdict table). For n = 0, median, even, min and max are null.

median.description: The median of sources_spanned as text: a whole number ("3") or one decimal ("2.5").
